title: Margin Call
description:
Several months of using leverage as a habit.
Today a text from your broker.
[Additional Margin Required]
The amount was on the screen.

choices.text: Pay it and close the position
choices.result_text:
You paid and closed everything.
Leverage doesn't amplify gains — it amplifies losses too.
₩2 million tuition.
Cheap, as lessons go.

choices.text: Put in more and hold
choices.result_text:
You put in ₩3 million more.
Another text came the next day.
Once you're caught in leverage, it's hard to cut yourself free.
That's what addiction is.

title: After the Big Win
description:
The speculative bet paid off big.
Word got around.
Today an acquaintance carefully asked:
"How did you do it back then? Could you show me?"

choices.text: Be honest. "It was luck."
choices.result_text:
'It was luck. Do the same thing again and I could lose.'
The person looked thrown off.
But it was true.
Not packaging one big win as skill — that's how you protect what comes next.

choices.text: Tell them roughly what you did
choices.result_text:
You explained the basics.
A month later word came back that they'd tried it and lost.
Same method doesn't guarantee same outcome.

title: The Return on Study
description:
Six months since you started studying ETFs.
From not knowing the terms — you now designed your own portfolio.
Today for the first time you wrote an investment plan in your notes.

choices.text: Buy the first ETF according to the plan
choices.result_text:
₩1 million.
The first investment where you knew why you were buying.
The return wasn't the difference — being able to explain why was.

choices.text: Study more before buying
choices.result_text:
You felt it was too early.
You kept studying.
The day you feel ready might never come.
At some point you just have to start.

title: The PB Meeting
description:
You finally got into the PB tier.
Today your first meeting with the assigned private banker.
"For an asset level like yours, this product would be suitable."
Listening to the explanation — something felt off.

choices.text: Review the proposal before deciding
choices.result_text:
You went home and broke down the fee structure.
PBs also have company products to sell.
Getting here was good — but here too, you had to look for yourself.

choices.text: Go with the PB recommendation
choices.result_text:
You went in as recommended.
It was a high-fee product.
Getting PB access doesn't mean delegating judgment.
A different layer — but still your job to look closely.

title: What That Information Did
description:
Two months since you went in on information of unknown origin.
Today you opened the account.
It was right.

choices.text: Lock in the gain and don't use that route again
choices.result_text:
You sold.
Whether it was skill or luck — unclear.
Even when unknown-source info is right — repeating that route will eventually cost more.
This was the last time.

choices.text: Use that route again next time
choices.result_text:
You reached out again.
The second one was right too.
The third was wrong — and that time there was an investigation too.
One success doesn't justify a bad route.

title: After the Report
description:
Three months since you reported the suspicious information channel to the FSS.
Today a text from the FSS.
[Report Outcome Notification]

choices.text: Check the result
choices.result_text:
[Investigation Opened]
The report was filed and an inquiry started.
No direct gain.
But the right thing was done — and a clean exit from that route.
Both confirmed.

title: IPO Result
description:
You participated in an IPO subscription two months ago.
Listing morning. You opened the chart.

choices.text: Sell at the opening price
choices.result_text:
Sold at open. Profit ₩800,000.
No greed. Clean exit.
IPOs often run up on listing day and come back down.
Small but certain.

choices.text: Looks like it'll go higher. Hold.
choices.result_text:
Next day: -12%.
The profit flipped to a loss.
Greed is when IPO gains disappear.
Small lesson. Expensive.

title: The Cost of the Gray Zone
description:
Two months since you decided to use the gray-area information.
You made money.
But today a call from the person who gave you the tip.
"You know you owe me something, right?"

choices.text: "I'll pay you for the tip in cash."
choices.result_text:
You transferred ₩1 million.
They said 'Clean.'
Gray-zone tips always come with a price.
This one ended with money. For now.

choices.text: "What do you want?" — hear them out
choices.result_text:
They made a request.
Not just money.
Step into the gray zone once — and getting out isn't easy.

title: After the Viral Moment
description:
Two months since a post went viral.
Followers spiked. Strangers commented.
Today back in ordinary life — nothing had actually changed.

choices.text: Turn it into something — keep creating content
choices.result_text:
You kept posting.
A second viral moment didn't come — but a small group of real readers stayed.
Interest has a short half-life. Content's half-life is longer.

choices.text: Accept the attention fading naturally
choices.result_text:
It faded naturally.
Fifteen minutes of fame.
Knowing that's not everything.
Once you know — it feels lighter.

title: What Came After the Bottom
description:
Eight months from the point that felt like rock bottom.
Today you opened old notes.
There was an entry: 'Can't get worse than this.'
With a date.

choices.text: Write down what happened since then
choices.result_text:
You wrote what had changed since that day.
A lot.
You need a floor to know which way is up.
That was true.

choices.text: Close it. Don't look back.
choices.result_text:
You closed it.
Even without looking back — you know where you're standing now is different.
That's enough.

title: The Ripple from That Honesty
description:
Half a year since you said 'Things aren't going well' at the reunion.
Today a message from the group — another friend said something similar.

choices.text: Reach out to that friend
choices.result_text:
'I was struggling then too. Still not easy now.'
They said '...I needed to hear that.'
Honesty calls honesty.
That one line traveled here.

choices.text: Leave it
choices.result_text:
You left it.
So a word said at a reunion spreads like that.
That one honest thing — had become someone's memory.

title: That Moment as a Mirror
description:
A year since you watched a senior's farewell.
Today someone else on the team announced they were leaving.
That gathering would probably look similar.

choices.text: Say goodbye in person this time
choices.result_text:
'You worked hard. I hope it goes well.'
They said 'Thanks. Take care.'
What you saw then changed how you acted now.
Watching and learning is also experience.

choices.text: Watch from your seat
choices.result_text:
You watched.
The face of the person leaving looked like the senior's.
What kind of place this is — confirmed again.

title: The Bankrupt CEO's Words
description:
You'd met an executive who'd once thrived and then gone bankrupt.
Something they said came back today, facing an investment decision.
"Where I went wrong was being too certain."

choices.text: Use that as a lens to examine this certainty
choices.result_text:
You checked three more things.
Your certainty went down.
So you went in smaller.
That CEO's bankruptcy — changed this decision.

choices.text: But this time my certainty is different.
choices.result_text:
You went in as planned.
Might be right.
But the bankrupt CEO probably said 'This time is different' too.

title: The Cost of Pride
description:
You've been running on pride, it seems.
Today suddenly — unclear whether this was your own goal or something to show someone else.

choices.text: Sort out the reasons again
choices.result_text:
You wrote it down.
Why Gangnam. Who it's for.
Half pride, half something real.
If half is real — that's enough reason to keep going.

choices.text: Whatever the reason — results matter
choices.result_text:
Results matter. You kept running.
But running on pride alone — sometimes even reaching the goal leaves you empty.
That was starting to make sense.

title: What the Straight Path Actually Is
description:
A year since you questioned whether the orthodox path was even right.
Today you added up what you'd built through steady work.
More than expected.

choices.text: The straight path is right. Keep going.
choices.result_text:
Slow, but it had accumulated.
Money made through speculation was lost through speculation — but this number remained.
The orthodox path isn't slow. Speculation's speed was an illusion.

choices.text: Still unsure. There's probably a faster way.
choices.result_text:
Still no clear answer.
But questioning while moving — better than moving without thinking.
The answer comes at the end.

title: The Day the Network Returned
description:
A year of consistent behavior with everyone you'd met.
Today an unknown number called.
"Hello, I got your contact through OO. Do you have a moment?"

choices.text: Set up a meeting
choices.result_text:
You met.
They were looking in the same direction.
A year of built reputation — made this table happen today.
Compounding isn't only for money.

choices.text: Find out who they are first
choices.result_text:
You checked the background.
A trustworthy route.
Set up the meeting.
Being careful was right. And waiting wasn't wrong either.
